scope: Original twelve storage accessories; calibration recipes only, not a renderer manifest.

coordinateConvention.exportedImageNormalized: Top-left origin; x / PNG width and y / PNG height, before engine alpha crop. Regions are manually annotated on actual exported art.
coordinateConvention.engineAlphaNormalized: Top-left of nonzero-alpha bounds; x=(normalizedX*width-alphaBounds.x)/alphaBounds.width and analogous y. Rect extents are scaled without subtracting origin.
coordinateConvention.alphaRule: All alpha > 0 pixels count, matching frontend/app/propremaster.js:60 through :68.
coordinateConvention.precision: Manual region annotations are approximate visual calibration; image sizes, hashes, alpha bounds and coordinate conversion are exact. Owner must validate overlays at game scale.
coordinateConvention.status: Recipe recommendations; no renderer changes or live verification.
coordinateConvention.canonicalInterface: view.regions is a name-to-polygon map; screenRegions is an array of polygons; motion contains the primary region/origin, RGB colour, trigger and mechanism, with additional per-effect layers when present. engineAlphaNormalized repeats these canonical fields after alpha-crop conversion. screenEffects and motionEffects retain full annotation/provenance descriptors.

sharedIntegrationRequirements: Retain catalog footprints, blocking, optional table mounting, leisure selection and simulation triggers independently of skin rendering.
Pass the existing native work flag; do not substitute idle clock, animation phase, or invented task progress for real trigger state.
Named modes below describe mechanism intent, not currently accepted propremaster.js manifest values. Owner must implement/adapt them; do not paste this JSON into the renderer manifest.
Clip surface motion to annotated polygons and actual subject alpha. Steam and light spill are separate overlay passes that may extend beyond subject alpha; never turn transparent cutouts opaque.
Static source pixels are not a completed motion implementation. Keep a working native fallback for functional work effects until the owner integrates and verifies their replacement.
